EndpointUrl.title: SipPulse vCon storage endpoint
EndpointUrl.description: HTTPS URL on api.sippulse.com that stores the final vCon in CRM and emails the transcript.

BearerToken.title: Temporary vCon storage bearer token
BearerToken.description: Optional pilot credential. Prefer SipPulse SSO for production.

AllowedEmailDomains.title: Allowed collaborator email domains
AllowedEmailDomains.description: Chrome profile email domains allowed to capture and receive the transcript email. Defaults to sippulse.com.

SipPulseAiApiKey.title: SipPulse AI API key (pilot)
SipPulseAiApiKey.description: Enables live transcription (pulse-stt-streaming-v1) and meeting notes/report. Must be a key for the SipPulse AI dev environment (api.dev.sippulse.ai). Readable on every enrolled machine: use a dedicated, rotatable key with a spending limit.

TypeSafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key (pilot)
TypeSafeApiKey.description: Enables inline per-utterance classification (intent, sentiment, action items) with the Jev model. Readable on every enrolled machine: use a dedicated, rotatable key.

CaptureEnabled.title: Enable meeting capture
CaptureEnabled.description: Optional kill switch. Defaults to enabled.
